profile.headline: Bitcoin Beast - AI Manger
profile.summary: I solve problems and make things happen.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: I led the development of Bitcoin products for businesses, including conversion, buying, selling, sending, and payments. What started as a Hackweek project has since grown into a full suite of products connecting Square merchants with Cash App customers.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: After identifying abuse of Square’s messaging services by scammers, I led a small team to build a scam detection platform and partnered with 10+ messaging product teams to protect their products. I also developed risk management training sessions across Square and interviewed 100+ candidates.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: When I joined the team, paging averaged 140 alerts per month; I led efforts to reduce this to fewer than 20 per month. Separately, I partnered with product teams to minimize payment fraud risk by building tailored data ingestion pipelines and integrating them into key decision points.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Skills: Java · Git · Software Design · Python · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
• Build and maintain APIs for key website functionality, including Add to Cart, Retrieve Product Information, and Get Product Categorization
• Collaborate with PMs and UX Designers to create smooth customer experiences
• Lead Agile meetings such as standup, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospective as Scrum Master
• Audited our web application for IDOR and XSS security vulnerabilities as well as for WCAG web accessibility standards
• Redesigned major feature providing a Checklist to customers

positions.title: Data Architecture Intern
positions.description:
•	Ported internal website from Python 2.7 to 3.7 and from Django 1.11 to 2.1
•	Analyzed and optimized server-side code to improve latency

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: •	Implemented data interpretation and conversion job using Spark and multiple GCP services including Google Dataproc, Google BitQuery, and Google Buckets

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Given a problem and parameters, developed a design that was reviewed and approved
•	Created data view tool using standard MVC design patterns
•	Implemented large backend solution for message handling and processing in Java, leveraging multiple AWS tools including SQS, DynamoDB, and EC2
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Git · Software Design · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Project Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed and performed quality assurance on large data sets in Microsoft Excel 
•	Led and participated in field efforts on client sites  
•	Performed Architectural, Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing take-offs

positions.title: Design Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed CAD models in SolidWorks, Autodesk Inventor, and AutoCAD
• 3D printed designs to be used by lab workers

positions.title: Student Event Manager
positions.description:
• Interacted with and help meet client needs
• Trained new employees
• Oversaw events at Georgia Tech Student Success Center
